summary.en: Three recap words as rows of neon tubes on an angled brick wall, running in opposite directions and lit one row at a time, then switched off row by row with a flicker.
summary.zh: 三个回顾词做成斜拍砖墙上的三行霓虹灯管字，行与行反向滚动、轮流点亮，结尾逐行闪两下熄灭。

fits: A recap or a rest before the end: three short words the film has earned (three steps, three promises), in a night or launch-party mood.
notFor: Words the viewer has not met before (they scroll and are only lit a third of the time); more or fewer than three; light, editorial or documentary styles.

overlaps.note: words passed from emblem to emblem; neon-marquee keeps three rows on one wall and only changes which is lit
one word per beat, centred; neon-marquee shows all three at once as scrolling signs

intent.en: Three words the film earned glow like signs on a street at night: a recap with a party mood before the end.
intent.zh: 片子挣来的三个词像夜街招牌一样亮起：带点派对气氛的回顾，收尾前喘口气。

content.en: Exactly three words, one word each (≤ 9 chars), already met earlier in the film.
content.zh: 正好三个词，每个 ≤ 3 字，片中前面已经出现过。

fits.zh: 收尾前的回顾或休息：三个片子已经讲过的短词（三步、三个承诺），夜景或发布派对气质。

notFor.zh: 观众没见过的词（会滚动，每行只亮三分之一时间）；不是三个；明亮、编辑感或纪录感的风格。

pairs.note: the wall powers down, then the lock-up on a dark frame

en: Each word is lit only a third of the time and scrolls: new words are not read.
On a light look the glow has nothing to glow against.
zh: 每个词只亮三分之一时间还在滚：新词读不出来。
浅色风格上光晕没有暗底可衬。
